title: Stonier Pies & Pinot (King's Birthday Weekend)
summary: Annual revival of the Stonier tradition: Pinot Noir duck pies; Chardonnay chicken pies; Chardonnay mushroom & tarragon pies made by Millers Bread Kitchen / Peninsula Backhouse. Available all weekend alongside new release 2025 Pinot Noir. See you by the fire. No bookings required.
